title: The Mud Men
text: Figures of mud rise from the marsh at dusk, one after another, and stand in a ring around the camp. They have no faces, only dimples where faces would be. They do nothing. They make no sound. They watch, all night, and the ring is a little closer at dawn.

options.label: Wait out the night inside the ring. They have done nothing yet.

outcomes.text: At dawn they sink back into the marsh. No one slept, and no one wants to talk about why.

options.label: Break the ring before it closes any tighter.
The wisest watches them back all night, to learn what they want.

outcomes.text: They are pointing. All of them, the same way, and that way is shorter. Nobody asks why they would help.
